This is the support reference for 1.0.0-rc.0. Sources below are pinned to the reviewed tree. A declared engine range is an installation requirement, not evidence that every matching version was tested.

## Runtimes

| Runtime                | RC boundary                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Source of truth                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Node.js                | The only supported durable runtime, with local SQLite. All 40 release packages declare exactly `engines.node: ">=22.19.0"`; no disagreements. CI and the release workflow pin `22.19.0`.                                    | [Manifest inventory](#published-node-engine-ranges); [CI toolchains](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/PACKAGE.ts); [release workflow](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/.github/workflows/release.yml)                                                                                                                                                |
| Node.js release smoke  | Reported runs: `22.19.0` and `24.18.0`. These versions are supplied by the release brief; no transcript of both runs is retained in this tree. The smoke checks tarball installation, imports, bundling, and typechecking.  | [smoke implementation and version output](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/scripts/smoke-release.mjs)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Bun                    | Non-durable package scope only, listed below. The adapter declares `engines.bun: ">=1.4.0"`; CI pins `1.4.1`. Durable stores refuse Bun with `unsupported_runtime`. This is not a claim that every application runs on Bun. | [adapter manifest](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/flows/platform-bun/package.json); [CI toolchains](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/PACKAGE.ts); [NodeDatabase runtime refusal](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/flows/database/src/node/NodeDatabase.ts) |
| Browsers               | bundle only. No durable flows, including when a caller supplies another SQL client.                                                                                                                                         | [browser bundle contract](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/scripts/browser-contract.mjs); [aggregate boundary](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/flows/docs/concepts/aggregate-surface.md)                                                                                                                                          |
| Deno and edge runtimes | Not supported. Browser bundling does not establish Deno, Cloudflare, or Vercel engine support.                                                                                                                              | [browser contract scope](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/scripts/browser-contract.mjs); [Node-only durable boundary](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/flows/database/docs/concepts/sqlite-only.md)                                                                                                                                |

### Bun package scope

These ten packages declare `bunTest` targets. The target uses Bun's package runner; the adapter README records that the resolved Vitest shim executes Node. This matrix does not establish native Bun runtime coverage. Application-specific Bun commands do not extend the package support boundary.

## Storage

| Boundary             | RC contract                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Source of truth                                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Durable store        | Local SQLite only. PostgreSQL, PGlite, browser SQL, and other supplied SQL clients are not supported durable stores.                                                                                                                                      | [SQLite-only policy](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/flows/database/docs/concepts/sqlite-only.md) |
| Schema compatibility | Existing policy: "The repository is unreleased, so each package has one authoritative initial schema rather than compatibility migrations for obsolete internal versions." This is not a promise of compatibility with earlier internal database schemas. | [journal migration policy](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/flows/journal/docs/api.md#migrations)  |
| 0.x run databases    | No loading, resuming, or migration of 0.x run databases. Source migration starts new runs.                                                                                                                                                                | [Compatibility policy](/docs/migration/compatibility/); [frozen policy](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/README.md)  |

## Network and hosting

| Boundary                 | RC contract                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Source of truth                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Gateway outside loopback | Requires explicit listen opt-in, bearer authentication, and TLS termination in front of the HTTP gateway. The Node gateway does not terminate TLS.                                                                                                                                                   | [network bind guide](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/gateway/docs/guides/serve-beyond-loopback.md); [HTTP server implementation](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/gateway/src/node/NodeGateway.ts)                                                                                                                           |
| Remote watch             | `ControlClient.credential` applies to HTTP. The default WebSocket transport is unauthenticated; it does not forward that credential. Remote watch is supported only through an authenticated transport/proxy that supplies the bearer on upgrade. A browser uses the documented authenticated relay. | [ControlClient transports](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/control/src/ControlClient.ts); [WebSocket relay requirement](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/gateway/docs/guides/serve-beyond-loopback.md#what-the-credential-then-covers); [Worker relay authentication](/docs/reference/http-api/#worker-relay-authentication) |
| Redaction                | Recognizes credential shapes and sensitive field names. It does not track secrets through arbitrary child output; a child's direct stderr bypasses the logger.                                                                                                                                       | [redaction evidence limits](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/scripts/repo-contract/fault-gaps.md); [journal redaction contract](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/flows/journal/docs/api.md)                                                                                                                                                     |

## Known limitations and evidence

| Area               | Limit                                                                                                                                                                  | Source of truth                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Global run listing | Loads the run population before paging. A page limit does not bound the underlying read or memory use. No scale claim. A named run has a separate direct lookup.       | [ControlLive list path](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/control/src/ControlLive.ts); [SQL listRuns](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/control/src/SqlControlRuntime.ts)    |
| Fault tier         | Bounded cases: hosted-provider faults, timer races, and other gaps remain. Passing the required fault job does not cover every failure mode.                           | [fault coverage record](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/scripts/repo-contract/fault-gaps.md); [fault job](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/PACKAGE.ts)                                                        |
| Soak               | The streaming case covers five subscribers and 500 events. No nightly soak runner is declared for the RC; hours-long growth and hosted soak are outside this evidence. | [case 16 and omitted soak tiers](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/scripts/repo-contract/fault-gaps.md)                                                                                                                                                             |
| Production canary  | Disabled for this repository. The job is guarded on `smithersai/flows`; it is not an RC validation surface.                                                            | [canary job guard](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/.github/workflows/canary.yml)                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Provider first use | A funded first-use provider run is not part of the automated release-smoke evidence. Tarball import/typecheck success does not demonstrate a provider conversation.    | [smoke scope](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/scripts/smoke-release.mjs); [release checks](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/.github/workflows/release.yml)                                                    |
| Project migration  | A realistic migrated project is not part of the automated release-smoke evidence. Migration fixtures and source rewrites do not establish that end-to-end result.      | [smoke scope](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/scripts/smoke-release.mjs); [migration verification guide](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/blob/66e5adf76a06c9556a398bdfa299d28d27bb87a1/packages/smithers/migrate/docs/guides/set-verification-commands.md) |
